name: True-Sworn
related_quests: Burning Secrets: Recover a book from an abandoned villa before it is burned to the ground.
Pledge: Black Drake Villa: Enter Black Drake Villa and return Undaunted.
A Mysterious Event: Crash an exclusive Waking Flame event and find an Ambition.
summary: The True-Sworn (or True Sworn) are a mysterious group that serve as Councilor Vandacia's personal guard. They are first encountered attempting to burn down Black Drake Villa, and later again, patrolling the halls of Vandacia's keep.
